title: Cluster of Organisms with No Recorded Relations
summary: This cluster consists of 11 organisms with no recorded relationships between them. The entities include Bromley EHC, Donald AM, Eftink, Jo J, Krebs MRH, Mergulhão FJ, Monteiro GA, Nijjer J, Price-Whelan A, Shammas SL, Soares, and Ziege R. Without any recorded connections, it is unclear how these organisms are related or what their commonalities might be.
